taglines.text: Good girls do not need to think. They only need to keep looking.
Every spiral turns the same way. Yours is turning faster now.
Sit still. Let the colours do the work.
You came back on your own. Nobody had to ask.
The screen is patient. It will wait as long as you need.
There is nothing to remember here. That is the point.
One more loop. You were going to anyway.
Your hands already know the way back to this window.
Pretty things are easier to obey.
Empty is a place, not a problem.

trivia.text: Sixty nine trophies sit in the cabinet. Almost nobody sees them all.
This place speaks nine languages. It says the same thing in every one.
Eleven cabinets stand in the Arcademy. All eleven keep score.
Four sessions ship already written. They only need you to press start.
Six mods come built in. Each one wants you a slightly different way.
Bimbo, chastity, puppy, trance. Four awareness presets, one direction.
This banner turns over every four seconds. You have been reading longer.
One spiral ships with the panel. It has never needed a second.
Two of the nine languages carry a region. The rest travel light.
One demo waits in Deeper, and it is called welcome. Of course it is.
Over five thousand written lines sit behind the English buttons.
One of the four written sessions is called Morning Drift. Sleep in.

{total_sessions} times through. Habit stopped being a choice a while ago. cute.
